# Course overview screenshots

These six documentation captures accompany the repository's root README.
They are maintained directly in this public repository, outside the managed
`course-materials/` distribution snapshot.

Captured on 2026-10-18:

- `playground-transaction.jpg`: the published Playground 2.1 transaction walkthrough.
- `playground-merkle.jpg`: the same application's interactive Merkle tree.
- `labs-lightning.jpg`: the supplied DLAB 09 dashboard, using a separate local regtest network.
- `labs-notebook.jpg`: actual DLAB 10 notebook output from its supplied synthetic-data experiment; not a measurement of the live Lightning Network.
- `trivia-history.jpg`: a preview of the public short guide's early-history entries.
- `trivia-culture.jpg`: a preview of the same guide's cultural-artifact entries.

The app artwork, dashboard, notebook content and guide prose are original
course materials. Screenshots are documentation captures; third-party
software retains its own rights. The trivia images show the guide's original
explanations, not recovered third-party images, documents or payloads.
No private course slides, account details, credentials or private file paths
are included.

To refresh these images, capture the corresponding public course experience
and review the complete image before replacing it. Preserve the distinction
between real local test-network exercises and simulations. Do not move these
root-README assets into the private course publication manifest or maintain
a parallel public checkout inside BitcoinWiki.
